form.label: Ride Reliability
form.description: Know the patterns. Prepare a backup.

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride | stats latest(park_name) as park_name by park_id

div.p: Know the patterns. Prepare a backup.

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_observed_day` | where complete_day=1 AND open=1 | eval window=case(_time<first_open+3600,"Opening hour",_time>last_open-3600,"Closing hour") | where isnotnull(window) | chart avg(wait_time) over park_name by window
`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_outage_segments` | where bounded=1 | stats median(duration_minutes) as Minutes

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_observed_day` | where complete_day=1 AND open=1 | eval window=case(_time<first_open+3600,"Opening hour",_time>last_open-3600,"Closing hour") | where isnotnull(window) | stats avg(wait_time) as Average perc95(wait_time) as P95 count as Samples by park_name park_local_date window | eval Average=round(Average,1),P95=round(P95,1) | sort 0 - park_local_date park_name window

table.title: Best rides near opening and closing

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_observed_day` | where complete_day=1 AND open=1 | eval window=case(_time<first_open+3600,"Opening hour",_time>last_open-3600,"Closing hour") | where isnotnull(window) | stats avg(wait_time) as Average perc95(wait_time) as P95 count as Samples dc(park_local_date) as Days by park_name ride_name window | eval Average=round(Average,1),P95=round(P95,1) | sort 0 Average

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_outage_segments` | where bounded=1 | stats count as Episodes median(duration_minutes) as Median perc95(duration_minutes) as P95 max(duration_minutes) as Longest by park_name ride_name | sort 0 - Median

chart.title: Unavailable likelihood by local hour · sampled frequency

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_observed_day` | where _time>=first_open AND _time<=last_open | eval unavailable=if(open=0,100,0) | chart avg(unavailable) over park_local_hour by park_name limit=10

table.title: Most likely unavailable hour for each ride

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_observed_day` | where _time>=first_open AND _time<=last_open | eval unavailable=if(open=0,100,0) | stats avg(unavailable) as Unavailable_pct count as Samples dc(park_local_date) as Days by park_id park_name ride_id ride_name park_local_hour | eval Unavailable_pct=round(Unavailable_pct,1) | sort 0 park_id ride_id - Unavailable_pct - Samples park_local_hour | dedup park_id ride_id | table park_name ride_name park_local_hour Unavailable_pct Samples Days

chart.title: Completed outage starts by local hour

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_outage_segments` | where bounded=1 | chart count over start_hour by park_name limit=10

table.title: Episode ledger · incomplete durations are not estimates

search.query: `queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_outage_segments` | sort 0 - start | table park_name ride_name local_start episode_status duration_minutes observed_minutes transition_uncertainty_minutes samples

`queue_times_index` sourcetype=queue_times:ride park_id=$park|s$ | `queue_times_observed_day` | eval first_label=if(_time=first_open,park_local_time,null()),last_label=if(_time=last_open,park_local_time,null()) | stats values(first_label) as First_open values(last_label) as Last_open max(complete_day) as Eligible count as Samples by park_name park_local_date | eval Comparison=if(Eligible=1,"Eligible estimate","Provisional / incomplete / short day") | fields - Eligible | sort 0 - park_local_date
